name: blanket-design-generator
description: Progressive Web & Native Mobile Crochet Blanket Design Generator

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive: true}); ['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/'+f)); ['css','js','icons'].forEach(d => fs.cpSync(d, 'www/'+d, {recursive: true}));"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:build:android: npm run build && npx cap copy android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:build:ios: npm run build && npx cap copy ios && npx cap open ios

author: Antigravity Team
